title: Better IV Scanner
description: A lightweight visual overhaul for IV Scanner of the mod IV scanner- cobblemon BY boboeditingg
body:
A lightweight visual overhaul for IV Scanner of the mod IV scanner- cobblemon **BY boboeditingg**

This pack replaces the default scanner presentation with:
- Adds a dedicated GUI/inventory sprite
- Adds a custom 3D held model

![In Game Scanner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/60dce218208ca5bc2a2bd2b4499583c372bafe78_0.webp)

![In Inventory Scanner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f060a068c2f2a50c4059cf47dff104e40780d285_0.webp)

Made for:
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric
- Cobblemon

Requires:
- [IV Scanner](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/iv-scanner)
- [Pommel - Held Item Models](https://modrinth.com/mod/pommel-held-item-models)

Credits:
- Original IV Scanner mod by boboeditingg
- Pack art/model work by Rocha
